calculation.description: Ranks each tradable asset by its lagged 20-trading-day return relative to the cross-sectional median, normalized by its lagged 20-day return volatility. The signal is evaluated against the following 10-trading-day return, with no future information used.

metrics.ic_definition: mean daily cross-sectional Spearman IC divided by sample standard deviation of daily ICs

validation.regime_notes: Positive in 2020-2026-07-15 (IC 0.0379 to 0.0589), negative during 2026-07-16 through 2028-12-31 (IC -0.0261), and strongly positive in 2029 through 2030-02-06 (IC 0.0845). Recent 119 qualifying dates from 2029-08-10 have IC 0.0566 and ICIR 0.2108; interpret small-universe regime estimates conservatively.
validation.provenance: 15 tradable benchmark instruments; daily cross-sectional Spearman IC; at least 8 valid instruments per date; inputs lagged one completed trading day.
